senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; טוּחַ I)plaster, lining of vessels.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:19">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 19</cite>, sq. [read, as R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:11">Kel. V, 11</cite>:] <he>אם יכיל הט׳ לעמוד בפני עצמו</he> if the lining can stand by itself (form a vessel of itself); v. <cite ref="E00314"><he>הֶטֵּחַ</he></cite>.
